newsitem.title: USA: ITT to sell five Sheraton hotels -- NYT.
newsitem.headline: ITT to sell five Sheraton hotels -- NYT.

text.p: ITT Corp, which is battling a hostile takeover bid from Hilton Hotels Corp, is expected to announce that it has agreed to sell five of its Sheraton hotels, the New York Times said.
In its Monday edition, the newspaper said ITT plans to sell the hotels to FelCor Suite Hotels Inc for $200 million in cash.
Since Hilton launched its $6.5 billion takeover bid in late January, ITT has been seeking to shed some assets in an effort to push up its stock price and keep Hilton from winning its bid.

Unnamed sources told the paper that under the deal, ITT Sheraton would continue to manage the hotels for 20 years. The hotels have more than 1,800 rooms and are located in Phoenix; Dallas; Atlanta; College Park, Georgia, and Rosemont, Illinois.
